facts.text: Jolene mentioned needing to be more mindful of her stress levels and take care of her mental health.

evidence.quote: I need to be more mindful of my stress levels and take care of my mental health. Sometimes I get too caught up in my studies and forget to prioritize self-care.

facts.text: Jolene expressed feeling overwhelmed due to exams and deadlines, which contributed to her stress.

evidence.quote: Exams and deadlines got me feeling overwhelmed. Just look at my to-do list! It seems never-ending... Trying my best but it's been challenging.
